description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests, comparing two categories: "Small model" (represented by blue bars) and a light blue category (likely representing a baseline or another model type). The horizontal axis lists various models, including Llama-3-3 70B instruct, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14b-instruct, GPT 4o, GPT 4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72b-instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and Phi-4. The vertical axis, labeled "Average score (temperature = 0.5)", ranges from 60 to 90. The Phi-4 model achieves the highest average score of 91.8, followed by Gemini Pro 1.5 with 89.8. The lowest score is recorded by Llama-3-3 70B instruct at 66.4. The chart shows a general upward trend in performance across the models, with Phi-4 significantly outperforming the others.
